note: The Java launcher sha256 is the mise-installed Temurin 21.0.8+9 launcher (NOT the mise shim). worker.java_binary() must resolve to this launcher on Linux (set XREG_JAVA to java_executable_path). verify_pinned_core() reads java's bytes and fails closed with validated_java_runtime_drift on any mismatch.
